title: TSA Regional Office: ASP Compromise Alert

transcript.speaker: TSA
transcript.text: This is Director Marcus Harmon with the TSA Regional Office. We've received intelligence from DHS/CISA that data consistent with an airport security program appeared on infrastructure associated with a foreign threat actor. We need to know: has your ASP been compromised? If so, we must initiate ASP revision procedures immediately. This call is SSI — do not discuss with media.

transcript.speaker: TSA
transcript.text: We need a confirmation and a timeline. The attacker may have used your ASP to map access controls, camera coverage, and emergency egress points. This is not a routine review — it's an emergency directive under TSA Emergency Amendments.

transcript.speaker: TSA
transcript.text: We will expect a remediation plan within 24 hours. If you confirm the ASP was exfiltrated, we will require immediate changes to physical security procedures and a full audit of all access control logs for the last 90 days.

voiceStyles.TSA: Male, mid-50s, clipped, urgent, background airport PA faintly audible

instructorNote: This inject escalates the threat to a regulatory level. The team must confirm the ASP was compromised, which they already know from prior injects, and begin drafting an emergency ASP revision plan under TSA authority.

citations.documentTitle: North Coast International Airport (NCIA) — Airport Security Program (ASP)
citations.headingPath: ASP › Section 3 › 3.5 Failure Modes (Contingency) (TSA Security Directive 1542-04-08G)
citations.quote: **Fail-Secure (Locked):** doors from Public to Secure default LOCKED on the exterior; physical key required. **Fail-Safe (Unlocked):** Emergency Egress Routes unlock on Fire Alarm. **Total System Fail

citations.documentTitle: North Coast International Airport (NCIA) — Airport Security Program (ASP)
citations.headingPath: ASP › Section 1 › 1.4 Amendments and Changes (49 CFR § 1542.105)
citations.quote: Airport-initiated amendments submitted to the TSA FSD at least 45 days before the effective date. TSA Emergency Amendments must be implemented within the timeframe specified.

citations.documentTitle: North Coast International Airport (NCIA) — Airport Terminal Incident Response Plan (TIRP)
citations.quote: - All Staff: RUN. HIDE. FIGHT.; call 911 or ACC with shooter location/description when safe. - LEO/Security: assume IC; contact teams; establish cold/warm/hot zones; declare scene secure for EMS. - Op
